recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a cowboy hat standing on a wooden post by the sea, characterized by a heavy, distressed film texture and a distinct three-color horizontal gradient wash.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically against a horizon line
Text left-aligned and positioned in the mid-left negative space
Color gradient transitions from teal to gold to rust-red across the frame
Heavy grain and border distressing unify the foreground and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical figure, standing full-length, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's silhouette and the guitar case resting beside him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the guitar case, then left to the typography, following the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left and right sides, filled with atmospheric texture and color washes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal (left) and rust-red (right) providing atmospheric depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow highlighting the center and the subject's form.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for typography and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; shadows are deep and crushed while highlights are warm and blown out.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the teal-toned negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif used for both artist and title for a unified, modern-rustic look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the narrow, bold, and functional feel of the original.
Provides the clean, condensed uppercase look with a modern edge.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of a man in a cowboy hat and sleeveless shirt standing on a wooden pier post by a calm sea at dusk. Apply a tritone gradient (teal, gold, rust) and heavy distressed film texture with a dark border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned, uppercase, condensed sans-serif text in the middle-left area using a dark charcoal color.

verificationChecks: Is the texture sufficiently gritty and weathered?
Does the color transition smoothly from teal to red?
Is the text condensed and left-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific stickers on the guitar case
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the border looks like a physical film edge.
Check that the text is legible against the teal background.
Verify the subject is standing on a post, not just the ground.
Confirm the gradient follows a horizontal left-to-right flow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject: [Man in Cowboy Hat] + Setting: [Coastal Pier] + Style: [Distressed Tritone Film] + Typography: [Left-Aligned Condensed Sans-Serif]
